_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_playable_permission_cost_reduction.py. t_pcr_arcanum is Urianger Augurelt's Play Arcanum on a plain artifact (no summoning sickness to dodge); t_pcr_plain_arcanum the same permission without the discount; t_pcr_recall grants a this-turn permission over a sorcery in your graveyard with the same discount, so a flashback card it reaches offers both lanes; t_pcr_heist exiles a card with a discounted permission through the exile op.
